name: Heating replacement & heat-pump lifecycle
thesis: Huge fossil/ageing heating stock plus accelerating heat-pump replacement creates lifecycle, compatibility, commissioning and spare-part demand, but Germany is already a mature merchant market.
falsifiers: manufacturer/installer channels fully solve exact model needs

name: Smart-meter / household energy visibility
thesis: 56m+ metering locations and low iMSys penetration create a forced transition with compatibility/monitoring decision friction.

name: Balcony solar / storage aftermarket
thesis: Large and rapidly expanding plug-in solar installed base can create monitoring, mounting, compatibility and storage-aftermarket demand, while generic kits are already saturated.

name: Exact-model EV aftermarket
thesis: Rapid electrified registrations and large charging base create exact-model/charging accessory demand; generic Tesla and charging categories are mature.

name: Old-building diagnostics / retrofit measurement
thesis: Large old fossil-heated building stock plus energy pressure supports professional diagnostics, but Germany has very strong domestic tool brands and merchant availability.
falsifiers: CPC too high relative to dealer margin

name: DIY repair / replacement parts
thesis: Online DIY growth and a huge installed durable-goods base can support exact part/model commerce, but manufacturer parts systems are mature.
falsifiers: manufacturer parts finders already capture demand
